basis: The dashboard legend explicitly maps pale yellow to 'High' (100) and dark red to 'Low' (0). The visual evidence confirms that New Jersey (NJ) is filled with pale yellow, indicating the highest prevalence among the options. Pennsylvania (PA) is dark red (low prevalence), and Delaware (DE) is orange-red (mid-range prevalence). The routing criterion is the 'Highest prevalence state in the dashboard'. Therefore, NJ is the correct state to route to the priority follow-up workflow.
